name: nginx-ui-swag
description: Official Nginx UI controller template for an existing LinuxServer SWAG container. The bundled Nginx instance is disabled. This template requires the Docker socket and a shared SWAG /config mount; review the security warning in the README before installing.

paths.name: Nginx UI appdata
paths.description: Nginx UI database, settings, and startup secret.

paths.name: SWAG appdata
paths.description: Use the same host directory SWAG mounts at /config. The container target must remain /config.

paths.name: Docker socket
paths.description: Required to test, reload, and restart Nginx in SWAG. Grants root-equivalent host control.

ports.name: WebUI port
ports.description: Direct Nginx UI backend port. Do not expose it to the internet.

variables.name: Disable bundled Nginx
variables.description: Run Nginx UI only and leave the bundled Nginx service idle.

variables.name: SWAG container name
variables.description: Exact Docker container name of the existing SWAG instance.

variables.name: Nginx configuration directory
variables.description: SWAG Nginx configuration directory in the shared mount.

variables.name: Nginx configuration file
variables.description: SWAG main Nginx configuration file in the shared mount.

variables.name: Nginx access log
variables.description: SWAG access log in the shared mount.

variables.name: Nginx error log
variables.description: SWAG error log in the shared mount.

variables.name: Nginx log allowlist
variables.description: Directory Nginx UI may read for log analysis.
